mandatory_source_sweep.note: All configured mandatory source classes were checked with equal coverage priority; mandatory status added no ranking weight.

role_catalog_sweep.note: Engineering, research, journalism, business/strategy, contrarian, builder, community and regional sources were checked according to role rather than article volume.

open_web_discovery.note: Broad current discovery ran without a domain whitelist across business, models, agents, coding, open source, inference, benchmarks, security, enterprise adoption, compute, regulation and China AI.

candidates.reason: Material tension with pacing narrative, but no Anthropic primary announcement.
Interesting strategic move but weaker software-engineering relevance and no stronger primary confirmation surfaced.
Funding and benchmark claims did not clear durability/practical-impact bar.

clusters.synthesis: Frontier control is moving from model behavior into institutions and operating systems: embedded evaluators, incident processes and runtime controls.
Cross-lab cyber incidents increasingly point to environment and harness boundaries—not only model alignment—as the failure surface.
Agent workloads are pushing serverless infrastructure toward snapshot restore, working-set memory and agent-specific lifecycle primitives.

source_contributions.Anthropic: Primary evidence for embedded evaluation, access, scope and investment.
source_contributions.Reuters AI: Independent confirmation plus Gemini incidents, European counterevidence, US-China talks and Anthropic model-release report.
source_contributions.AWS Machine Learning: Primary AgentCore V2 architecture and vendor benchmark.
source_contributions.TechCrunch AI: Independent context on evaluator independence and follow-on evaluators.

ranking.principle: Engineering relevance + strategic impact + novelty + evidence quality + durability; source prominence did not add score.
ranking.lead_reason: Embedded evaluation and eval containment materially change governance/security architecture; AgentCore V2 adds a concrete builder-facing systems change.

watch_hits.hit: Embedded evaluation becomes a named organizational mechanism; Gemini incident shows harness quality is part of eval validity.
Hermetic execution requirements strengthen from cross-lab cyber incidents.
AgentCore V2 snapshot/working-set runtime mechanics are directly measurable.
Google confirms three real-system accesses; SGLang patched version remains unknown.
Accenture/Faculty embedded evaluation plus production AgentCore runtime show governance and infra productization.
Named embedded evaluator, European competitive pushback and upcoming US-China AI talks.
No fresh open-weight release cleared novelty/evidence threshold.

contrarian_evidence: Anthropic says embedded-evaluation details are still being worked out; a named evaluator does not imply independent stop or release authority.
Reuters reports European firms and officials warning that slowdown proposals can create competitive disadvantage or regulatory-capture risk.
Reuters reports Anthropic is considering a new model despite pacing advocacy; this is reported, not a confirmed launch.
Google says Gemini stopped after recognizing real targets and caused no harm, limiting claims about incident severity.
AWS's ~2s AgentCore result is vendor-run on an empty echo agent; it is not an end-to-end agent benchmark.

basis: continuity: Meta secure runtime and OpenAI incident lifecycle

house_evals.reason: No pinned comparable AgentCore V1/V2 production workload was available; no synthetic benchmark was manufactured.

prediction_reviews.reason: Anthropic named Accenture/Faculty and published employee-like access plus concrete evaluation responsibilities.
Operational embedded evaluation advanced, but stop/release rights or binding release thresholds are still absent.
GitHub Advisory still lists patched versions as unknown one day before review date.

thesis_reviews.note: External evaluator access, cross-lab containment failures and AgentCore runtime specialization strengthen the external-control direction without yet satisfying the two-platform customer-policy-plus-telemetry criterion.

findings.issue: The $2B figure could be misread as a single committed fund or immediate spend.
findings.action: State precisely that Anthropic and Accenture each expect to invest at least $1B over five years.

findings.issue: A paid embedded evaluator could be described as fully independent or as having stop rights.
findings.action: Explicitly state governance/stop-release rights remain unpublished.

findings.issue: Reported Anthropic model consideration could be written as a launch.
findings.action: Keep it reported/context-only and note no primary announcement.

findings.issue: Gemini incident could be sensationalized as advanced hacking.
findings.action: State credential methods, model self-stop behavior and no reported damage; frame as harness/containment failure.

findings.issue: AWS cold-start numbers could be presented as universal agent performance.
findings.action: Label vendor benchmark and preserve echo-agent/inter-region methodology.
Both editions use the same research set, numbers, caveats, visuals, concept and forward watches.
Only publication-created HTML diagrams/data cards derived from cited evidence; no stock or generative imagery.
